title: "Mallard Duck Movement"
author: "mollyburke1208"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards_roi <- mallards |>
  filter(
    between(lat, 46, 55),
    between(long, 7, 25)
  ) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(
  scale = "medium",
  returnclass = "sf"
)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "grey95", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = mallards_roi, aes(color = duck_id), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(7, 25), ylim = c(46, 55), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(color = "Duck") +
  theme_minimal()
```
